title: 醉翁亭记

full_english: The Old Drunkard's heart is not in the wine, but in the hills and streams.

title: 醉翁亭记

classical_sentence: 同舍生皆被绮绣，戴珠缨宝饰之帽，腰白玉之环，左佩刀，右备容臭，烨然若神人。
full_english: My fellow lodgers wore embroidered silks and caps hung with pearl tassels and jewels, girdles of white jade, a knife at the left, a scent-bag at the right, radiant as gods.

title: 送东阳马生序
meaning_in_this_sentence: 香袋（róng xiù，『左佩刀，右备容臭』）
classical_sentence: 同舍生皆被绮绣，戴珠缨宝饰之帽，腰白玉之环，左佩刀，右备容臭，烨然若神人。

title: 送东阳马生序
meaning_in_this_sentence: 乱麻为絮的袍子（yùn，『缊袍敝衣』）
classical_sentence: 余则缊袍敝衣处其间，略无慕艳意。
full_english: I, in worn padded gown and ragged clothes, dwelt among them without the least envy

title: 送东阳马生序
meaning_in_this_sentence: 破旧衣服（敝：破旧）

title: 送东阳马生序
meaning_in_this_sentence: 毫无（『略无慕艳意』，略：全、一概）
classical_sentence: 余则缊袍敝衣处其间，略无慕艳意。
full_english: I, in worn padded gown and ragged clothes, dwelt among them without the least envy

title: 送东阳马生序
meaning_in_this_sentence: 足以快乐的事（中：心中）
classical_sentence: 以中有足乐者，不知口体之奉不若人也。
full_english: for what sufficed to make me happy was within: I did not feel my food and clothing inferior.
term_english: what sufficed to make me happy

title: 送东阳马生序
meaning_in_this_sentence: 句首发语词，表推测、引起下文，可译为『大概、想来』
classical_sentence: 盖余之勤且艰若此。
full_english: Such were the toil and hardship of my studies.

title: 送东阳马生序
meaning_in_this_sentence: 本句『侍坐』即陪侍在旁（非『因……获罪』）
classical_sentence: 今虽耄老，未有所成，犹幸预君子之列，而承天子之宠光，缀公卿之后，日侍坐备顾问，四海亦谬称其氏名，况才之过于余者乎？
full_english: Now, though old with nothing achieved, I have luckily joined the ranks of gentlemen, enjoying the Emperor's glorious favour, trailing behind dukes and ministers, daily in attendance for consultation, and my name is, undeservedly, known across the realm — how much more those whose talent surpasses mine!

title: 送东阳马生序
meaning_in_this_sentence: 天下、全国（古人以为中国四周环海）
classical_sentence: 今虽耄老，未有所成，犹幸预君子之列，而承天子之宠光，缀公卿之后，日侍坐备顾问，四海亦谬称其氏名，况才之过于余者乎？

title: 送东阳马生序
meaning_in_this_sentence: 天下共主之称，本句泛指皇帝
classical_sentence: 今虽耄老，未有所成，犹幸预君子之列，而承天子之宠光，缀公卿之后，日侍坐备顾问，四海亦谬称其氏名，况才之过于余者乎？

title: 送东阳马生序
meaning_in_this_sentence: 官府供给的粮食（廪稍之供）
classical_sentence: 今诸生学于太学，县官日有廪稍之供，父母岁有裘葛之遗，无冻馁之患矣；
full_english: Now the students study at the Imperial Academy: the government supplies daily grain, parents send yearly winter and summer clothing, so there is no fear of cold and hunger

title: 送东阳马生序
meaning_in_this_sentence: 冬衣（裘）与夏衣（葛），代指四季衣物
classical_sentence: 今诸生学于太学，县官日有廪稍之供，父母岁有裘葛之遗，无冻馁之患矣；
full_english: Now the students study at the Imperial Academy: the government supplies daily grain, parents send yearly winter and summer clothing, so there is no fear of cold and hunger

title: 送东阳马生序
meaning_in_this_sentence: 本句为『坐』的本义：坐在（非『因……获罪』）
classical_sentence: 坐大厦之下而诵《诗》《书》，无奔走之劳矣；
full_english: they sit beneath great halls reciting the Songs and Documents, with no toil of running about

title: 送东阳马生序
meaning_in_this_sentence: 《诗》即《诗经》，本句谓引其文为据
classical_sentence: 坐大厦之下而诵《诗》《书》，无奔走之劳矣；
full_english: they sit beneath great halls reciting the Songs and Documents, with no toil of running about

title: 送东阳马生序
meaning_in_this_sentence: 《书》即《尚书》，本句谓引其文为据

full_english: they sit beneath great halls reciting the Songs and Documents, with no toil of running about

title: 送东阳马生序
meaning_in_this_sentence: 官名，国子监司业，协助祭酒掌儒学训导
classical_sentence: 有司业、博士为之师，未有问而不告、求而不得者也；
full_english: Assistant Supervisors and Erudites serve as their teachers — none asks without being told, none seeks without obtaining

title: 送东阳马生序
meaning_in_this_sentence: 本句『手录』即亲手抄写（非『总领』）
classical_sentence: 凡所宜有之书，皆集于此，不必若余之手录、假诸人而后见也。
full_english: all the books one ought to have are gathered here, with no need, like mine, to copy by hand or borrow from others before seeing them.

title: 送东阳马生序
meaning_in_this_sentence: 本句『假诸人』即向人借（假：借）
classical_sentence: 凡所宜有之书，皆集于此，不必若余之手录、假诸人而后见也。
full_english: all the books one ought to have are gathered here, with no need, like mine, to copy by hand or borrow from others before seeing them.

title: 送东阳马生序
meaning_in_this_sentence: 天资（『非天质之卑』）
classical_sentence: 其业有不精、德有不成者，非天质之卑，则心不若余之专耳，岂他人之过哉！
full_english: If their learning is still unrefined and their virtue imperfect, it is either that their natural endowment is lowly or that their concentration falls short of mine — how could it be the fault of others!

title: 送东阳马生序
meaning_in_this_sentence: 本句『称』为称许、称赞（非『著称』）
classical_sentence: 东阳马生君则，在太学已二年，流辈甚称其贤。
full_english: Ma Junze of Dongyang has been at the Academy for two years, and his contemporaries greatly praise his worth.

title: 送东阳马生序
meaning_in_this_sentence: 把……作为（『以之为』省略）
classical_sentence: 余朝京师，生以乡人子谒余，撰长书以为贽，辞甚畅达；
full_english: When I came to the capital for audience, the young man called on me as a fellow-provincial junior, presenting a long letter as his gift, its style fluent and lucid

title: 送东阳马生序
meaning_in_this_sentence: 本句『论辩』即辩论（非通『辨』）
classical_sentence: 与之论辩，言和而色夷。
full_english: in debate with him his words were mild and his countenance even.

title: 送东阳马生序
meaning_in_this_sentence: 本句『言和』指言语温和（和：温和，非『应和』）
classical_sentence: 与之论辩，言和而色夷。
full_english: in debate with him his words were mild and his countenance even.

title: 送东阳马生序
meaning_in_this_sentence: 本句『用心』即费心、用心力（非『因为心思』）
classical_sentence: 自谓少时用心于学甚劳，是可谓善学者矣。
full_english: He says that in his youth he laboured hard at learning — he may truly be called a good learner.

title: 送东阳马生序
meaning_in_this_sentence: 本句为『求学的人』（古之学者必有师），非现代『学者』
classical_sentence: 自谓少时用心于学甚劳，是可谓善学者矣。
full_english: He says that in his youth he laboured hard at learning — he may truly be called a good learner.

title: 送东阳马生序
meaning_in_this_sentence: 做学问（为：做；道：说，讲述其难）
classical_sentence: 其将归见其亲也，余故道为学之难以告之。
full_english: As he is about to return home to see his parents, I therefore tell of the difficulty of learning to instruct him.

title: 送东阳马生序
meaning_in_this_sentence: 勉励、鼓励（勉乡人以学：勉励同乡人学习）
classical_sentence: 谓余勉乡人以学者，余之志也；
full_english: To say I encourage my townsmen to study — that is my intent

title: 送东阳马生序
meaning_in_this_sentence: 遭遇，此处指受到的恩遇（『夸际遇之盛』）
classical_sentence: 诋我夸际遇之盛而骄乡人者，岂知予者哉！
full_english: to say I vaunt my good fortune and am proud before my townsmen — that is to know me not!
